blocks.source: Labyrinth Starが落ち着いてきたのに伴い、次なる作品の開発に取り組んでいます。次なるというか、６年も前から制作中の作品なので、正確には『制作再開』といった感じです。そんなわけで、そろそろ開発記録の記事を上げていきます。
blocks.translation: Now that things have settled down with Labyrinth Star, I am working on developing my next game. Or rather, since it is a project I have been working on for six years already, it would be more accurate to say that development has resumed. With that in mind, I will be starting to post development logs soon.

blocks.source: ※既にコメントや過去の記事でも書いていますが、次の作品が完成した際には、シェアウェアなどで収益を上げることも検討しています。実際にどうするかは当分未定ですが、フリーを前提に期待されると心苦しいのでご了承ください。
blocks.translation: ※As I have already mentioned in comments and previous posts, I am considering earning revenue through shareware or similar means when my next game is completed. I have not yet decided exactly what I will do, but I would feel bad if people expected it to be free, so please understand.

blocks.source: 既に６年間で３～４０００時間を制作に費やしており、ここから更に完成までには２～４０００時間程度、必要と予測しています。参考までに、Labyrinth Starの制作時間は精々１０００～１５００時間程度です。素材を自作する率が遥かに大きいという理由もありますが、作品規模の違いが分かるかと思います。
blocks.translation: I have already spent 3,000–4,000 hours developing it over the past six years, and I estimate that it will require another 2,000–4,000 hours or so to complete from this point. For reference, Labyrinth Star took at most around 1,000–1,500 hours to develop. One reason is that I am creating a much higher proportion of the assets myself, but I think you can get an idea of the difference in scope between the two games.

blocks.source: 時代はLabyrinth Starの３００年後。世界を舞台にした古典的ＲＰＧです。
blocks.translation: The game is set 300 years after Labyrinth Star. It is a classic RPG set across the world.

blocks.source: 物語的には続編というほど強い繋がりはありません。
blocks.translation: In terms of its story, it is not strongly connected enough to be called a sequel.

blocks.source: ドット絵を強化中。頑張ってＳＦＣ風味を出したいと思います。ＳＦＣ版ＤＱ３の影響丸出しですね。
blocks.translation: I am improving the pixel art. I would like to work hard to give it a Super Famicom-style feel. The influence of the Super Famicom version of Dragon Quest III is pretty obvious.

blocks.source: 中盤、船を手に入れてからのＤＱ３的な自由度の高さを是非とも実現したい所です。
blocks.translation: In the middle portion of the game, I would really like to achieve the same high degree of freedom as in Dragon Quest III after obtaining the ship.

blocks.source: 主人公はドラクエ的な喋らないタイプです。でも、仲間は結構喋ります。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is the silent type, like in Dragon Quest. However, the companions talk quite a bit.

blocks.source: 雰囲気的にはＤＱ８だとか、ブレスオブファイア２，３辺りをイメージしてもらうと良いかと思います。
blocks.translation: In terms of atmosphere, I think it would be helpful to imagine something like Dragon Quest VIII or Breath of Fire II and III.

blocks.source: 効果音以外の素材はグラフィックから音楽まで、ほぼ自作する予定です。
blocks.translation: I plan to create almost all of the assets myself, from graphics to music, except for sound effects.

blocks.source: 完成時期は自分の状況やモチベーションによって、変わってくるかと思います。現状は暇な身分なので、今の内にできるだけ制作を進めたいところです。制作状況については毎週更新できるほどのネタは無いので、１ヶ月に１～２回程度を目安に上げていく予定です。
blocks.translation: The completion date will probably vary depending on my circumstances and motivation. I currently have plenty of free time, so I would like to make as much progress as possible while I can. I do not have enough material to post development updates every week, so I plan to post them roughly once or twice a month.

blocks.source: あと、RPG制作講座とかも、多少ネタが溜まったので、久々に更新するかもしれません。
blocks.translation: I may also update the RPG Design Guides for the first time in a while, since I have accumulated some material.

lines.source: 内容は僕が長年夢見てきたＳＦＣ風長編王道ＲＰＧです。[[LINK_1]]過去の記事[[/LINK_1]]とも重なりますが、快適なテンポでプレイ時間３０時間程度、とＦＦ５等ＳＦＣの大作ＲＰＧにも劣らない規模の作品を目指しています。Labyrinth Starはこれの外伝的作品で、こちらの本編からシステムを流用したものです。

parts.source: 内容は僕が長年夢見てきたＳＦＣ風長編王道ＲＰＧです。
とも重なりますが、快適なテンポでプレイ時間３０時間程度、とＦＦ５等ＳＦＣの大作ＲＰＧにも劣らない規模の作品を目指しています。Labyrinth Starはこれの外伝的作品で、こちらの本編からシステムを流用したものです。

lines.translation: It is the long-form, classic-style SFC RPG I have dreamed of making for many years. It overlaps with [[LINK_1]]Past Articles[[/LINK_1]], but I aim to create a game with a comfortable pace, around 30 hours of playtime, and a scale that does not fall short of major SFC RPGs such as FF5. Labyrinth Star is a spin-off of this game, using systems borrowed from the main game.
